lines.text: The lights are low and the Shoal is talking in its sleep.
Clarissa wins the Reprieve (Spelling Sprint) and spends the shell to leave the Marked; Kiki names Mina in the shell's place
The Ebb takes Mina (57-7); Marea carries Mina to the Spirits

lines.name: Bessent
lines.text: The fog is where pressure builds. Position early.

lines.name: David
lines.text: Lessons From the Sea, Lesson 2. Back to the lantern light. Courage first, then surrender.

lines.name: Dara
lines.text: Small thing. I agreed with everyone today. Interesting results.

lines.name: Cato
lines.text: Low tide is not in your control. Your answer to it is.

lines.name: Cleo
lines.text: To wash or not to wash the last biscuit: that is the question.
Morning is coming. Sleep while it lasts.
